facts.fact: 他到家看到 Blair：瞳孔乱窜、面如石头——对两个女人都不可读。
facts.anchor: His pupils dart wildly from left to right, but his face remains like stone.

facts.fact: 关键闪回：Blair 曾把 Nova 解读的录音放给他听——糟糕又救命的决定。
facts.anchor: the night after my reading with Nova when I played him the recording.

facts.fact: 逃亡的完成：一记膝顶、袜子当冰刀、钥匙还插在锁孔——空手而逃。
facts.anchor: I thrust my knee into his groin and watched him crumple to the floor. And then I ran.

facts.fact: 带走的东西只有一样：他的车钥匙。
facts.anchor: Except the keys to his car.

facts.fact: 他当面演戏：装作初次见面——咧嘴「我是 Finlay」。
facts.anchor: ‘I’m sorry. I think there must be some mistake,’ he lies to my face, straightening his back and grinning from ear to ear. ‘I don’t think we’ve met before. I’m Finlay.’

facts.fact: Cassie 当场倒戈指认：你叫 George，你骗了我。
facts.anchor: ‘Your name is George. You…you lied to me. You’re not who you say you are.’

facts.fact: 他背对两人拧动钥匙——把她们锁在屋里。
facts.anchor: He turns his back to us, takes a couple of steps and turns the key, locking all of us inside.

facts.fact: 他的介绍词：我「已故」的女友——还没死透，还在踢腿。
facts.anchor: ‘Cassie, this is Blair. My dearly departed – yet not so dead, after all – girlfriend. Alive, and for now, very much still kicking, it seems.’
